_comment: Sales rep name as written in column B of the commission sheet -> QuickBooks vendor display name. For a shared deal list each vendor; each is paid the row's full commission unless a "share" (e.g. 0.5) is given. "2nd Comm" is the vendor paid the sheet's 2nd Comm column (the 0.5% override). "2nd Comm by invoice" sends one invoice's 2nd Comm to someone else (e.g. Cecile instead of Ann).
